title: Supplementary materials for: Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape
description: Supplementary materials for the manuscript Urban planning leaves an audible legacy in a megacity’s bird soundscape, prepared for Communications Earth & Environment. Includes Supplementary Information, Supplementary Data 1–17, Supplementary Figures 1–10, R and Stan code, and public summary data. Exact coordinates and restricted source data are excluded.
